card.name: Linking words in opioid antagonist instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (that, and, by, be) inside two repeated label sentences: the antagonist-for-respiratory-depression sentence and the 'it is suggested that a standard protocol' sentence for malignant hyperthermia.

modes.label: Antagonist care and titration
modes.description: Linking words in the sentence about starting the antagonist with care and by titration with smaller doses.
modes.example: administration of the antagonist should be initiated with care<< and>> by titration with smaller than usual doses

modes.label: Suggested protocol
modes.description: The word 'that' after 'it is suggested' before a standard protocol for malignant hyperthermia.
modes.example: cannot be predicted in advance, it is suggested<< that>> a standard protocol for the management of malignant
